visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-angle close-up of a lavish Vietnamese beef rib pho bowl featuring large, meaty ribs and a small Vietnamese flag; several side dishes including sliced chicken and dipping sauces are arranged on a clean white table under bright indoor lighting. (2) Hands enter the frame to lift a massive bone with thick, tender beef attached, showcasing the scale of the meat over the bowl of white rice noodles and fresh herbs. (3) The scene cuts to a large commercial kitchen pot where beef ribs are simmering in a bubbling, dark brown broth, followed by a close-up of clear hot broth being poured from a traditional golden teapot directly over raw slices of wagyu beef in the bowl. (4) Detailed shots show the thick rib meat being pulled apart and dipped into a savory sauce, highlighting the texture and juiciness of the protein. (5) The focus shifts to a tray of Hainanese chicken rice where glossy sliced chicken is picked up with chopsticks and dipped into a sweet and sour sauce; the background remains a minimalist white restaurant interior. (6) A bowl of grilled pork slices over rice is presented, followed by a Vietnamese savory pancake being opened to reveal fresh shrimp, pork, and bean sprouts, then wrapped in a crisp lettuce leaf. (7) A hand holds up a plastic cup of Vietnamese iced coffee and then a cup of Thai green milk tea against a backdrop of a modern restaurant with green neon signs. (8) The final sequence shows the restaurant's clean, modern interior with yellow seating and text overlays listing branch addresses, concluding with a night view of the restaurant's storefront.
